---
title: "Workflow flowcharts"
description: "Create, adopt, tailor and debug a client with user and pipeline flowcharts."
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Workflow flowcharts}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

```{r workflow-content, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat(readLines('workflow.md', encoding = 'UTF-8')[-1L], sep = '\n')
```

<style>
@media (min-width: 1200px) {
  .container.template-article { max-width: calc(100% - 2rem); }
  .template-article .row > main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; max-width: none; }
  .template-article .row > aside { width: 12rem; margin-left: 0; }
}
.mermaid svg { min-width: 48rem; }
</style>

<script type="module">
import mermaid from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@11.12.0/dist/mermaid.esm.min.mjs';
for (const code of document.querySelectorAll('pre.mermaid > code, code.language-mermaid, code.mermaid')) {
  const diagram = document.createElement('div');
  diagram.className = 'mermaid';
  diagram.style.overflow = 'auto';
  diagram.textContent = code.textContent;
  code.closest('pre').replaceWith(diagram);
}
mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, flowchart: { useMaxWidth: true } });
await mermaid.run();
</script>
